topic: How to Maintain Productivity in a Crisis
title: How to Maintain Productivity in a Crisis
session_title: How to Maintain Productivity in a Crisis
abstract: Staying focused, clear, productive, and creative can be challenging at any time, given all of the many stimuli that we encounter every day. And of course, this is exacerbated when we are navigating a challenge or a crisis. In this session, we will discuss strategies and tactics to give you a boost and help you remain centered and mission-focused during any circumstance and especially in the middle of uncertainty. We will also address how to leverage the challenge to strengthen your resolve and skills and those of your team.
presenting_author: Alaina Levine | University of California, Los Angeles
